file_write.scope: Only scripts/check_gene_models.py may create the user-specified new JSON report in an existing local directory; it may not replace a path, mutate an input, repair an annotation, recurse, decompress, use the network, or start a subprocess.
file_write.reason: The bounded checker must publish one explicit structural-QC report; create-exclusive publication prevents annotation mutation and output replacement.

target_enforcement.openai: Allow only the explicit new local JSON report path; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.claude: Allow only the explicit new local JSON report path; remote inline execution is forbidden.
target_enforcement.generic: Run locally and allow only the caller-approved create-new JSON report.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit write approval is required for the new report path.
